title: Double-clicking an HTML file does not open Chrome — orphan headless Chrome
symptom: A double-clicked html file shows nothing, or web open hangs
cause: A headless Chrome whose profile is gone (PPID 1) is left running and receives the default Chrome requests
fix: Clean up orphans with launch_cli.py web close --stale (other people's live browsers are only reported)
By hand: in ps -axo pid,ppid,command | grep -- --headless, look for entries with PPID 1
If reconnecting hangs, open with a new absolute --root, keeping in mind the login will be gone
